originalFivePredicates.declarationAuthority: Root implementation-free collaboration declaration, 2026-10-07; original semantics to preserve, not an author assertion
originalFivePredicates.E: result.error === undefined; any defined value refuses, including null/false/string/0/empty string

originalFivePredicates.objectStrictness: For ordinary bounded parsed JSON, helper shape refusal is compatible with the original five-predicate outcome: non-object/array inputs cannot satisfy the entire conjunction. No arbitrary JS proxy/accessor/class/descriptor/prototype guarantee is inferred.

diagnosticRequirements.exactExportAndSchema: DECLARED in root-owned docs/contracts/ollama-response-envelope-v1.md; exactly nine enumerable data fields with closed boolean/enum domains. Source/helper/fixture execution remains NOT_RUN.
diagnosticRequirements.finiteSemanticProjection: Only declared boolean/finite enum facts about the five predicates and bounded input-shape/refusal classes. Pinned-name class is finite; arbitrary returned name/error/role is never echoed.
diagnosticRequirements.truthfulness: errorField present means original error !== undefined, including defined falsy values; for parsed JSON absent is the passing error case. Known not-inspected domains permit skipped predicates after refusal; they are not fabricated false facts. First refusal order shape,error,completion,response model,assistant role is declared and must match; it cannot identify unavailable historical facts.
diagnosticRequirements.sizeBudgetStatus: Proposed offline specimen check ceiling; root must freeze exact finite schema/size before execution. It is not a new declared original runtime interface.
diagnosticRequirements.scope: Diagnostic projection contains no billing, native authority or semantic verdict. Existing validated usage observations remain separate.
